title: Battle of Sarandí
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sarandí", at revision 1379903525, opens: "The Battle of Sarandí was fought on 12 October 1825, in the vicinity of the Arroyo Sarandí in Uruguay, between troops of the Banda Oriental and the Empire of Brazil. It resulted in a decisive victory for the Orientals." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2387020, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between troops of the Banda Oriental and the Empire of Brazil during the Cisplatine War fought on the shores of Sarandi Creek in 1825". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
